cohort: Human uterine samples from cesarean deliveries and virgin female mice
finding: HPOT and FBOT demonstrated higher potency and partial agonist efficacy in inducing uterine contractions compared to oxytocin in both human and mouse uteri.
mod_finding: Both HPOT and FBOT showed promising results as potential uterotonics for preventing postpartum hemorrhage, especially HPOT which showed additivity with oxytocin and the ability to overcome atosiban inhibition.
